title: Performance ledger: shape-actors environments, scenery and catalogue (Nov 2026)
intro: Experiments from redrawing every environment of a code-drawn 2D stage (kids' learning app) and then paying back what the richer art cost: scenery loaded per environment, objects prepared on first use, no hidden drawing under painted scenes. Numbers come from the suite in suite/ on a 4-vCPU cloud VM (Node 22; Chromium CPU throttling for browser recordings: 6x = low-end phone). Each A/B was measured in one session, interleaved: compare within a row, not across rows. Raw files: runs/ and experiments/results/.
